quote: I pasted our domain the week before launch, watched the log run, and had a ranked list of gaps before my coffee got cold. Every line in the log was a real request, so I never wondered where a number came from.
name: Daniel Foster

quote: The launch plan gave us something to do about the score. We split the directories that afternoon and had them all submitted by Friday.
name: Oliver Bennett

quote: Finally a tool that tells me where my competitors are listed instead of selling me a month of consulting.
name: Ananya Sharma

quote: The Open Graph fix alone was worth it. Our launch post looked like a real company's, and it got noticeably more clicks than the one before it.
name: James Murphy

quote: I liked that it showed every request it made. No black box, nothing to install, no account. It respected our robots.txt the whole way through.
name: Sarah Williams

quote: We had no idea only 3 of our pages were indexed. Submitted the sitemap the same day.
name: Lucas Martin

quote: Plain language, with the actual number from our site in each sentence. Most tools hand you a red icon and a link to a long article. This told me what to fix and where to submit.
name: Emily Parker

quote: I fixed our structured data from the guide without hiring anyone, then re-ran the check an hour later and watched the technical score move.
name: Rahul Verma

quote: Ran it on three competitors for fun. Humbling, and useful for choosing where to launch.
name: Tom Richardson

quote: The directory list saved me an afternoon of guessing. I picked the five that matched our audience, filled each profile from one text file, and two were live within the week.
name: Michael Okafor

quote: A single line in our robots.txt was telling crawlers to skip our docs folder. We had carried that mistake for a year. Nothing else we use had flagged it.
name: Sophie Laurent

quote: Easy to share. I sent the report link to our designer and the OG image was done by evening.
name: Alex Turner
